guides.name: DPS Ranger PvP Build — Game8

$join.$t: PvP-гайд из интернета, не с Questlog: {site}, автор {author}. Собран помощником по статье — сверяйтесь с оригиналом.

$join: A ranged damage setup for larger PvP fights built around Snipe, Tempest Shot and Deadshot. It slots four damage and AoE stigmas (Illusory Arrow, Arrow Storm, Griffon Arrow, Explosive Arrow), PvP Attack / PvP Damage Boost / PvP Critical Hit / PvP Accuracy manastones and the Magic Arcana set. Slow pursuers first, then hit groups with the AoE chain before they close the distance.

skills.note: Game8 also lists a third option (25% cooldown reset) that Deadshot does not have in the client; choose the third slot yourself.
Part of the main chain; Game8 keeps it low with no specializations.

rotation: Before the fight: Snare Shot → Drill Dart → Gale Arrow → Illusory Arrow.
When a group approaches: Explosion Trap → Explosive Arrow → Griffon Arrow → Arrow Storm.
Main chain: Marking Shot → Suppressing Arrow → Burst Arrow → Deadshot; fire Deadshot whenever it is ready.
Most damage comes from Snipe, Tempest Shot and Deadshot — keep them at the highest levels.

tips.title: Deadshot on its own key
tips.text: Game8 binds Deadshot to a dedicated key so it can go out alongside the Precision skills the moment it comes off cooldown.

tips.title: Chain delay
tips.text: Set the in-game chain delay to roughly half of your ping.

tips.title: Hit them before they reach you
tips.text: This is a damage build for bigger fights: open on groups with the AoE chain while they are still closing in, and keep Snare Shot and Illusory Arrow for anyone chasing you.

tips.title: Magic Arcana as a safety net
tips.text: The Magic set restores MP when you fall below 20% HP, which buys one more burst before you go down.

tips.title: Pantheon god stats
tips.text: Game8 ranks Pantheon stats as Destruction, Illusion, Death, Space, Time; its summary box lists Destiny instead of Illusion and Space, so check the article.

guides.name: PvP Control and Survival Build — Fextralife

$join.$t: PvP-гайд из интернета, не с Questlog: {site}, автор {author}. Собран помощником по статье — сверяйтесь с оригиналом.

$join: A control and survival setup that keeps melee divers off you with healing reduction, seals and traps placed under your feet. Stigmas are Vaizel's Authority, Bow of Blessing, Sealing Arrow and Ensnaring Trap. Defiance and Snare Shot are maxed first, and stats favour Accuracy and survivability over raw damage.

tips.title: Burst Arrow needs Slow or Root
tips.text: Stun, Seal and Airborne don't enable Burst Arrow's bonus damage — land Snare Shot or a root first.

tips.title: Precision is only for the stun
tips.text: Suppressing Arrow does its damage without Precision; Marking Shot first only matters for the stun.

tips.title: Specializations before level 20
tips.text: Until the third specialization slot opens at skill level 20, run the first two picks of each skill.

tips.title: Space control over damage
tips.text: The build wins by keeping melee away (healing reduction, seals, traps) and breaking out of hard CC with Defiance, not by out-damaging them.

tips.title: Long fights
tips.text: In drawn-out fights swap Bow of Blessing for Supporting Fire for HP leech and extra shots.

$join: A small-scale PvP setup assembled from two Korean Ranger players' videos; the page marks it as work in progress. The Ranger is treated as a fragile burst class that fights from about 20 m: Deadshot, Burst Arrow and Defiance go to 20, with Vaizel's Authority, Mother Nature's Breath, Ambush Kick and Stealth as stigmas. PvP Damage Boost goes on every manastone.

Gale Arrow, then a fully charged Deadshot; finish with Burst Arrow.

tips.title: Don't get caught
tips.text: The Ranger is fragile: fight from around 20 m and avoid being caught. 1v1 is fine; 1v3 is about the limit with current Accuracy.

tips.title: Stealth against Gladiators
tips.text: Don't open from Stealth. Use it to wait out a Gladiator's 3-second invulnerability, then re-engage.

tips.title: Ambush Kick
tips.text: Use it at point-blank range or on someone trying to escape; in party PvP it can buy your healer one more cast.

tips.title: Cure potions
tips.text: Gladiators and Chanters debuff you — carry cure potions to clear them.

tips.title: Accuracy or Evasion
tips.text: The two Korean builds split: one stacks Accuracy, the other Evasion (said to cap at 50%). HP, Defense and Will (against Templar knockdowns) matter because you take as much damage as you deal.

tips.title: Stigmas that didn't make it
tips.text: Sealing Arrow and Illusory Arrow were tested and judged not worth a slot. A damage variant runs Vaizel's Authority, Bow of Blessing, Supporting Fire and Griffon Arrow with Deadshot and Gale Arrow at 20.

tips.title: Work in progress
tips.text: The article says this PvP build is assembled from Korean videos rather than a tested global build — check it against the original.
